lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately three horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are visible on the posterior lateral flank. The most prominent central row features blobs spaced at intervals roughly twice their diameter, creating a linear series of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal blob rows, particularly in the mid-flank region, forming a non-orthogonal grid where blobs act as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two dominant longitudinal features are visible along the upper flank. The primary ridge shows a sharp luminance transition from highlight to shadow, running parallel to the dorsal-lateral interface. A secondary, less pronounced ridge is visible running through the upper-most row of blobs.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 8-10 elongated high-contrast silhouettes (remoras) is visible trailing and attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
